newsitem.title: UK: S&P has no comment on talk of Turkish rating move.
newsitem.headline: S&P has no comment on talk of Turkish rating move.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Wednesday it had no comment on market talk it was set to make a statement on the Republic of Turkey's sovereign ratings.

Konrad Reuss, a director of the sovereign group at S&P, said it was company policy not to comment on such rumours and he declined to say whether the agency was planning any statements or reports on Turkey.
He said he could only reiterate the agency's latest view on the ratings. "Turkey is on CreditWatch with negative implications," Reuss said.
S&P put Turkey's B plus long term and B short-term foreign currency ratings on negative watch in July.
Earlier on Wednesday, Turkish banking sources in Ankara said S&P was expected to make a statement this month about Turkey.
